memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: reports mild abdominal discomfort after meals, occasional loose stools; able to drive long distances without pain. cognition: Mini-Cog 5/5 (recall 3, clock draw normal). falls: no falls in last 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 9 seconds (normal). medicines: 6 regular (mebeverine, ispaghula husk, loperamide SOS, clobetasol, calcipotriol, methotrexate with folic acid); polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria. mood: denies low mood or anxiety; reports occasional frustration with skin flares. carers: spouse (husband) – primary support. goals: "I want to stay symptom‑free so I can keep working and care for my family."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: MRI lumbar spine: L4‑L5 disc bulge causing mild indentation of the thecal sac; no significant nerve root compression. Mild degenerative changes at L3‑L4. No cord signal abnormality.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referral to Orthopaedic Spine Clinic, Narayana Health, for evaluation of lumbar disc bulge and sciatica symptoms. Request clinical correlation, consider physiotherapy and possible epidural steroid injection if conservative measures fail.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Orthopaedic spine review: patient examined, neurologic exam normal. MRI findings discussed; advised trial of structured physiotherapy core strengthening, NSAID as needed, and lifestyle modification. No surgical intervention indicated at present. Follow‑up in 3 months if symptoms persist.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Message via clinic app: "Over the past week I’ve had more frequent loose stools after meals, with urgency. My skin psoriasis has flared on elbows and scalp, itching worse. Back pain is unchanged."

memories.text: function: bowel movements now 2‑3 formed stools per day, no urgency; skin plaques mild, scaling only; back pain occasional after long drives, relieved with stretching. cognition: Mini-Cog 5/5. falls: no falls; gait steady; timed up-and-go 9 seconds. medicines: 6 regular (mebeverine, ispaghula husk, loperamide SOS, clobetasol, calcipotriol, methotrexate+folic acid, pregabalin, diclofenac, methylcobalamin) – total 9; polypharmacy – discuss deprescribing loperamide PRN. mood: stable, denies depression. carers: husband. goals: "I want to keep my gut calm and skin clear so I can keep driving without worry."
